direction: Full-colour bold cover (Kieran, 2026-11-02: stand out more, obvious who it is for, characters in full colour on the cover only; the interior stays black and white). Whole wrap in court blue, in the same layout as the Golf Addict's Guide so the two read as a series. Front: a coral gift strip, the title stacked in big condensed capitals (cream, with ABOUT ANYTHING ELSE in warm amber) and the subtitle over the empty blue top of a full-bleed picture: Josh demonstrating a padel shot to his newborn son while Lauren stares flatly from the sofa, Mia lies face-down on a cushion and the racket bag sits where the buggy should be. Author on a black label at the foot.
author: Kieran Smith
subtitle: A formal engagement for the man who has made padel his whole personality
back_copy:
Your stakeholders have commissioned an engagement.

Eighteen months ago you took up padel. Since then you have mentioned it in 94% of conversations lasting longer than four minutes. You have told a midwife it is the fastest-growing sport in the world. The racket bag is in the boot, and the buggy is not.

This is the programme pack: nine phases, twenty-six activities, stakeholder feedback from home and work, a daily padel budget, a relapse risk register and a certificate at the end, if you earn it.

For every padel convert who answers the 6am group chat before the baby, and for everyone who has to listen to him.

banner.text: The perfect gift for the man who won't stop talking about padel
